text: Is the person awake and responding normally right now? Are they having severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding?
He is awake but answers slowly; he is not having chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding.
Can you tell us what happened, when it started, and how bad the pain is on a scale from 0 to 10?
His symptoms of swelling, yellowing eyes, and confusion started worsening over the past two days. He reports mild abdominal discomfort at 3/10.
Has he had any face drooping, arm weakness, or slurred speech today?
No, he has not had face drooping, arm weakness, or slurred speech today. He is awake and breathing normally but answers slowly.

sources: ESI v5 p.12 (New Onset Confusion, Lethargy, or Disorientation)

text: Can you tell us exactly what happened, when it started, how bad the pain is on a scale of 0 to 10, and also let us know if he takes any regular medicines or has any allergies or medical conditions like heart problems or diabetes?

He has cirrhosis from chronic hepatitis B; his abdomen got swollen over the last two days with yellow eyes, sleepiness, confusion, and shaky hands. He reports mild abdominal discomfort at 3/10 and takes lactulose, spironolactone, and furosemide but missed some doses, with no blood thinners or known allergies.
